dishes.name: Stillwater
dishes.subtitle: A colony learns to feed
dishes.rule: Quiet currents. Learn which organisms nourish and which poison.

dishes.name: Glassgarden
dishes.subtitle: Life between the reeds
dishes.rule: The tide reverses every 18 seconds. Linked glass shields can regrow.

dishes.name: Blue Deep
dishes.subtitle: A light in the dark
dishes.rule: Linked predators arrive in pairs. Fit both nuclei inside one membrane.

stages.name: First nourishment
stages.lesson: Green lobed desmids are food. Purple spiked cysts poison. Drag through any ready blue cells, return to the first, then release.

stages.name: New life
stages.lesson: Enclose the small pearl-colored spores to bring them home. Gather food as well. Orange hunters must not reach the mother.

stages.name: The nursery
stages.lesson: Feed the mother and remove three threats. Food thieves and hunters both count. The small bell bud inhales, then opens its gold center for capture. Watch its breath.

stages.name: The Bellwether
stages.lesson: Like the bell bud, it draws food and poison inward, then opens for 16 seconds. Charge with three food and capture its gold center during the exhale. Repeat three times.

stages.name: Clear a passage
stages.lesson: A membrane containing ONLY cysts neutralizes them safely in this encounter. Separate the poison from food; mixed meals still hurt.

stages.name: Turning tide
stages.lesson: Feed from three different sectors. Amoebas can swallow a blue cell: loop around their gold nucleus within 15 seconds to rescue it. An eaten cell regrows next encounter.

stages.name: Glass cradles
stages.lesson: A glass cradle protects the first pearl. Capture both linked shields together, or the second within 18 seconds, then rescue the pearl. Rescue three spores in all.

stages.name: The Glass Regent
stages.lesson: Use what the glass cradle taught you: break both shields together, or the second within 18 seconds. Spend three food charge to hit the exposed nucleus.

stages.name: Shared shelter
stages.lesson: Remove four threats and gather food. Linked Twinspores share a membrane: both hearts must fit in your loop.

stages.name: A clean current
stages.lesson: Neutralize six cysts in poison-only loops. Keep a safe feeding route open while the deep current moves the colony.

stages.name: Seeds of tomorrow
stages.lesson: Bring four pearl spores home. Your evolved colony must balance feeding, protection, and rescue.

stages.name: The Conjoined
stages.lesson: Spend three food charge to enclose BOTH hearts. They spread farther after each hit; wait for them to meet, or draw a wider loop. Young pairs hatch nearby. Capture them before they reach Mother.

colonies.name: The Wanderer
colonies.detail: An adaptable beginning. Eight-cell membranes, no tradeoffs.

colonies.name: The Weaver
colonies.detail: Starts with Rapid Fission. Small loops recover in two seconds.
colonies.unlock: Guide a colony out of Stillwater

colonies.name: The Symbiont
colonies.detail: Starts with Symbiosis. Captured predators also nourish the colony.
colonies.unlock: Guide a colony out of Glassgarden

mutations.name: Rapid Fission
mutations.detail:
3-4 cell loops recover in 2 seconds.
Keep a nimble route near the mother.
mutations.tradeoff: Larger loops keep their usual recovery.

mutations.name: Elastic Membranes
mutations.detail:
Connect up to 10 cells in one loop.
Catch pairs or distant groups together.
mutations.tradeoff: Every loop takes 0.6s longer to return.

mutations.name: Enzyme Sacs
mutations.detail:
Loops of 6+ cells deal two damage.
Digest a Shellback in a single capture.
mutations.tradeoff: Those loops take 1.2s longer to return.

mutations.name: Feeding Frenzy
mutations.summary: A feast keeps your start alive.
mutations.detail:
Digest 3+ bodies in one loop and its
starting cell stays immediately ready.

mutations.name: Osmotic Lure
mutations.detail:
Each loop gently draws nearby enemies
toward it. Prepare your next capture.

mutations.name: Residual Membrane
mutations.detail:
A loop leaves a brief membrane.
Crossing enemies slow by 40% for 1s.

mutations.name: Filter Veil
mutations.detail:
Filter the first cyst in each meal.
Choose richer, contaminated pockets.

mutations.name: Feast Chambers
mutations.detail:
Four or more desmids give +2 food.
Plan a generous enclosure.

mutations.name: Delicate Grazer
mutations.detail:
One or two desmids give +1 food
if the membrane causes no poison.

mutations.name: Symbiosis
mutations.detail:
Each captured threat gives +2 food.
Guard the mother while she feeds.
mutations.tradeoff: Cracking armor alone gives no food.

mutations.name: Bitter Catalyst
mutations.detail:
Each cyst in a meal gives +2 food.
Combines with the Filter Veil.
mutations.tradeoff: Unfiltered cysts still cost an organelle.

mutations.name: Living Nursery
mutations.detail:
Every 12 clean desmids regrow
one of the mother's organelles.
